categories.title: Monuments
categories.summary: Your memory, embodied in granite. A wide range of models and an individual approach.
categories.description: Your memory, embodied in granite, will live forever. At Narva Rituaal, you can always choose a beautiful and durable monument that meets your preferences. In our showroom, we always have more than 100 monument models in stock. We work only with the best granite suppliers from India, Karelia, Finland, and Ukraine.
advantages: Huge selection of monuments of any shape, color, and price
We fulfill orders of any complexity based on your sketches
Manufacturing of a monument in 2 days
Fair prices and individual approach, installments, warranty
services: Photoceramics, photo on enamel, portraits on glass
Free storage of the finished monument until installation

categories.title: Framing
categories.summary: Enclosures and architectural design of burial sites. A dignified and well-kept appearance.
categories.description: A fence at a grave is a crucial element of the architectural design of places where your loved ones find their final resting place. To give the burial site a worthy and well-kept appearance, you don't need to spend time and money traveling from company to company. Simply contact our granite workshop, and all your wishes will be fulfilled on time, with high quality, a guarantee, and a mandatory discount!
options: Framing with granite cladding - from 350 EUR
Framing with rubble stone finishing - from 300 EUR
Granite framing with pillars - from 800 EUR
services: Free cemetery visit with our designer
We fulfill orders at all cemeteries in Estonia

categories.title: Exclusive
categories.summary: Unique granite monuments and complexes, created in a single copy.
categories.description: Exclusive granite monuments and complexes are works created in a single copy. They reflect the individual characteristics of a person, their inner world, character, and Character. Elite monuments are an opportunity to pay special tribute, express love, and the pain of loss. Our designer will carefully discuss all your wishes and help in creating a unique project of any complexity.

categories.title: Landscaping
categories.summary: Burial site maintenance and landscape design. An impeccable look for years to come.
categories.description: We want people coming to the grave of a loved one to focus on their feelings and emotions, not on household issues of caring for the grave. Narva Rituaal improves graves in such a way that they look impeccable even after years.
